focus_area_title: Communicate Across Differences to Support Inclusion
content_text_body:
Honest, open and active communication is an essential ingredient to build inclusive interaction among your team members. People perform better when they feel heard, understood, and appreciated. 

### Adjust your communication style to be more inclusive 
Consider how your perspective will resonate across your team and take the time to acknowledge your unconscious biases by examining the assumptions, attitudes and stereotypes that affect your views, actions, and decision-making. 

### Listen for values and feelings
"Tune inâ€ to the needs and issues being expressed. Don't just listen for facts, instead be open to understanding what might be affecting someone's experience in the workplace.   

### Build bridges for communication 
Create opportunities for your team to interact and strengthen relationships. Create a safe environment for communication where team members can opening share and learn about each other's different backgrounds and perspectives. 
 
### Recognize the mistakes in your message 
Apologize when you make a mistake. Don't ignore it or excuse it. Work through the discomfort and support authenticity.

Read more about ways to grow [inclusive communication](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbescoachescouncil/2016/06/07/11-ways-male-leaders-can-adjust-communication-in-order-to-be-more-inclusive-to-women/#4e7aec324638).
